name: auto-review
description: Opt-in Codex plugin that uses Stop hooks to review a completed task, detect structured review findings, fix them, and repeat review until clean.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically review and repair Codex task changes after Stop.
interface.longDescription: Use the global $auto-review skill to arm an opt-in Stop hook. When the task finishes, the hook asks Codex to review the latest changes, parses a required structured result, and asks Codex to fix and review again when real issues are found.
defaultPrompt: $auto-review Implement this task and auto-review it at Stop.
$auto-review Fix this bug, then run the auto review loop.
$auto-review Make this change with automatic post-task review.
